title: Siddhu The Warrior
desc: A rich man does everything he can to restore his mother's failing health. However, finding no success, he follows the advice of a sage who tells him to turn into a beggar for 48 hours.

title: Samba
desc: Samba and Pasupathi become sworn enemies after Pasupathi's wife, who is Samba's sister, commits suicide. Things worsen when Samba wants to fulfil his father's dream but Pasupathi stands in his way.

title: Businessman 2
desc: A money-minded tycoon gets into a beneficial relationship with a woman. Soon, he learns about the differences in his family and decides to end them.

title: Virunnu
desc: After John Kalathil, a prominent businessman, takes his own life, his wife is involved in an accident. At death's door, she assigns Hemand, an auto driver, the responsibility of conveying a secret.

title: The 100
desc: A brave IPS officer deals with a unique mission of finding the culprits behind the robberies taking place at the outskirts of a city.

title: Qatil Saya
desc: A police officer investigates the mystery behind unnatural deaths after taking charge of his new post at a hill station.
